authority: NASA LP DAAC / MODIS Land Team
classification: IGBP Land Cover Type 1 sub-pixel class percentages
forest_definition: sum of IGBP classes 1-5: evergreen needleleaf, evergreen broadleaf, deciduous needleleaf, deciduous broadleaf, mixed forest
download_requires: NASA Earthdata bearer token; raw HDF is transient and must not be committed
interpretation: Used only to estimate land and forest area spatially overlapping mapped hazard footprints; it is not observed damage or forest loss.
known_issue: NASA cautions users when interpreting MCD12Q1/MCD12C1 Version 6.1 land-cover layers for 2021 and later because the supervised-classification training database was not continuously updated and some training sites may have changed land cover.
